uncited: - A structured 3D volume grid of dimensions $\Delta x \times \Delta y \times \Delta z$.
- A list of active cells whose scalar range $[v_{min}, v_{max}]$ contains $t$.
The interval tree is a binary tree where each node stores a subset of cells.
Calculate $v_{min}$ and $v_{max}$ for every cell in the volume.
Store $S_{contain}$ in the current node's `min-list` and `max-list`.
Start at the root node with threshold $t_0$.
- Stop when encountering a cell with $v_{min} > t$ (since the list is sorted ascending, subsequent cells will also fail).
- Stop when encountering a cell with $v_{max} < t$ (since the list is sorted descending, subsequent cells will also fail).
- Report all cells in the current node's lists.
- **Degenerate Input:** If all cells have the same $v_{min}$ and $v_{max}$, the tree depth becomes 1, and all cells are stored in the root.

The algorithm calculates `min*1` as the minimum of the cell's coordinates $(cellx, celly, cellz)$ and `min*2` as the minimum of the distances to the opposite boundaries $((\Delta x-1)-cellx, (\Delta y-1)-celly, (\Delta z-1)-cellz)$.
The layer index is the minimum of `min*1` and `min*2`.
Inside the layer, the cell is inserted into the appropriate plane list based on which coordinate matches the boundary plane.
The method selects a subset of cells such that every edge in the volume grid is covered by at least one selected cell.
Since an edge is shared by four cells, only one out of four neighboring cells needs to be considered.
After extraction from the data structure, the isosurface is propagated from the reported active cells onto neighboring cells that were not covered in the data structure.
- **When to use:** When memory is sufficient and fast single-query extraction is required.

- **When not to use:** When memory is constrained (use [Interval Tree with Cell Grouping](1342-interval-tree-with-cell-grouping.md) or [Edge-Covering Space Reduction]) or when multiple queries are needed (consider [Search Data Structure Based Isosurface Extraction](6738-search-data-structure-based-isosurface-extraction.md)).
